  -- Result: Reported Henry Scheffé lifespan as 1907–1977 (70 years) to the Planner, noting the discrepancy.
- Agent: Planner

  -- Observation: Multiple reliable sources (Wikipedia, MacTutor) agree on 1907–1977; one source (Find a Grave) says 2010.
  -- Thought: The scholarly consensus (1907–1977) overrides the single outlier. Calculated lifespans: Csaba (45 years) vs. Henry (70 years).
  -- Result: Concluded Henry Scheffé lived longer (70 years vs. 45 years) and marked task complete.
